slots.title: New York AG secures up to $35 million and lifetime crypto ban from Celsius’ Alex Mashinsky
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Alex Mashinsky, already serving 12 years for fraud, settled New York’s civil case over claims he misled Celsius customers about the failed crypto lender’s safety.

slots.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.

slots.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.

slots.title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice.

slots.title: The maker of non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B just weeks after launch
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: What has users and large corporations so excited about Jev is TypeSafe’s claim that it works significantly faster and uses far fewer tokens than LLMs.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Long live the mechanical keyboard
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Keychron made a name for itself after launching on Kickstarter in 2017. Today, it offers the value K2 model as well as a variety of other versions, including one with an all-wood body.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
